title: Kronos Guide
subtitle: Gallente Marauder
body:
# Kronos

---

The Kronos is a Gallente marauder running an armor fit in our fleets and is a primary DPS ship

## Key Points

- Always load 2 range scripts in your tracking computers and 1 scan res script in your sensor booster.
- Activate Bastion when in position. It locks you in place for 60 seconds but dramatically boosts your  damage.
- Don't bastion with aggro unless an FC tells you to.
- Use Void for close range (<16), Null for longer range(>25). Switch ammo types based on what range you're shooting. If the target is between the two ranges, shoot whichever ammo you are already shooting or whichever is best for the next spawn.
- Use your armor rep when battle reps are called for.
- Use your cap transmitter when battle caps are called for or when a ship asks for it.
- Auto repeat off is stupid. You lose 3% dps because you aren't smart enough to press a button once at the end of the site.
- Overbastioning by 10 seconds is better than under bastioning by 50 seconds.

## Bastion Timing

- NRF- get to your anchor then bastion for the remainder of the site. If you get initial aggro on entry then you can wait until the switch to bastion first cycle.
- TPPH - room 1 and 2 you do not bastion. Room 3 get to your anchor and bastion until the tower is low armor/enters hull. 
- TCRC Boomer strat - If you are not assigned: a role bastion one cycle on the beacon. once you exit bastion mjd and bastion one more time. Follow FC directions for any additional bastion cycles but you should only bastion twice.
- TCRC Split strat - If you are not assigned: MJD, bastion, wait for aggro swap, if not on you, bastion 2nd cycle. Follow FC directions for any additional bastion cycles but you should only bastion twice.


## Anchoring
- NRF Straight - Jump straight forward, burn back approximately 25 km slightly anticlockwise of straight back (10-15 degree offset). 
- TPPH - Rooms 1-2 burn to out gate, Room three top left of the tower approximately 8500m from the tower and as close to last wave spawn as you can.
- TCRC Boomer strat - If you are not assigned: a role bastion one cycle on the beacon. once you exit bastion mjd and bastion one more time. Follow FC directions for any additional bastion cycles but you should only bastion twice.
- TCRC Split strat - If you are not assigned: MJD, bastion, wait for aggro swap, if not on you, bastion 2nd cycle. Follow FC directions for any additional bastion cycles but you should only bastion twice.

## Target Priority

- TPPH:
    - room1 tama , outuni , auga, osti, vylade, frigs
    - room2 renyn , romi , deltole, rest
    - room3w1 mara , frigates , romi , osti
    - room3w2 romi , intaki , deltole , osti
    - room3w3 outuni , i do not care

- NRF:
    - w1 mara , vylade , whatever is in range
    - w2 romi , osti , rest
    - w3 mara , romi , rest
    - w4 outuni , romi , intaki , rest

- TCRC (Boomer strat):
    - deltole , outuni , untagged osti , tower (do not shoot tag x at the beginning , kill x schmaeel and x auga after tower)

- TCRC (split strat):
    - 2 yulai above the tower , tower (do not shoot tag x at the beginning , kill x schmaeel and x auga after tower)

## Fleet Roles
- LR - in TCRC's jump forward and shoot the tower immediately with bastion. Red cycle your bastion, if you don't get the first swap then go back in for another cycle.

## Upgrade planning
- get to the dps requirement->get ascendancies->get the rest of the pod->get faction bastion->upgrade damage mods to like 1b each mod level->plate->mwd->pashans->omega asc
